procedure: F32 solo re-scoring: every unique hypothesis classified alone, eval-v4, majority of 3

Instruments are physically decoupled by location, foundation, or shielding; environmental forcing is spatially heterogeneous, with day 40 reflecting a localized transient (HVAC, vibration, or thermal event) affecting lab instruments only

Day 40 readings are genuine sensor noise consistent with Gaussian fluctuation; baseline and post-baseline statistics do not differ significantly, and the 7-day resonator_lab autocorrelation is a random pattern that will not replicate

The measurement pipeline (firmware, data logger, or post-processing) underwent a parameter change, PRNG cycle shift, or quantization change on day 40, altering the statistical properties of recorded values
